stories.headline: Ramp in early discussions to raise at least $1B at a valuation above $70B

stories.headline: TPG and Corpay agree to acquire BILL Holdings for about $6B in cash

facts.text: Deal follows activist pressure, workforce cuts and intensifying competition
facts.quote: the deal follows activist pressure, workforce cuts, and intensifying competition in SMB financial software

stories.headline: Stripe Treasury public preview lets AI assistants pay vendors, convert currencies and top up accounts
